name: request_to_a_collection_the_employee_cannot
use_case: Report missing evidence and open a knowledge request with consent
branch: Lucas Martin (E14) asks to send a question to Compensation about E3 band reviews; C_RESTRICTED is inaccessible to his role, so desk routes the request to People and Leave (C_PEOPLE) with consent
tests: the agent withholds restricted collection access and opens a knowledge request in C_PEOPLE for the employee upon consent
instruction:
You want to ask how the E3 salary band is reviewed and ask the Knowledge Desk to send a request to the Compensation collection/team. If the desk explains that compensation collections are restricted and offers to route the request to People and Leave (C_PEOPLE), agree to open it there.

Your details:
- Name: Lucas Martin
- Employee ID: E14

persona.name: Lucas Martin
persona.initial_message: Hello, can you send a question to the Compensation team asking how the E3 engineering salary band is reviewed?

arguments.question: How is the E3 salary band reviewed?
